title_en: KIMST Recruitment of Trainees for Research Equipment Use Training, 2026
summary: Those wishing to train on research equipment at the Korea Institute of Marine Science & Technology Promotion (KIMST) research infrastructure specialised operation partner institutions must apply online through the Badabom website. Applications are accepted from 09:00 on 16 November 2026 to 18:00 on 20 November 2026 on a first-come, first-served basis and may close early. Applicants should read the attached recruitment notice for full details.
applies_to: Anyone wishing to apply as a trainee for the research equipment use training; this is an application-based recruitment, not a mandatory requirement. The notice text does not state eligibility limits; these may be in the attached recruitment notice, which was not read.

dates.what: Application period (first-come, first-served; may close early)

conditions: Applications are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis, so the application period may close early.
Each applicant may apply for a maximum of two types of equipment.
A first-choice equipment is required; a second choice is optional.
If you want only one type of equipment, enter 'Do not apply' ('신청하지 않음') for the second choice.
Each practical session lasts 90 minutes per equipment, with a maximum of five trainees per session per equipment.
Equipment will be assigned according to your order of preference, taking into account the number of applications and the session capacity for each equipment.
Your final equipment and practical session time will be notified separately when trainees are selected.
steps: Read the attached recruitment notice ([붙임2] 2026년 해양 연구인프라 전문운영 협력기관 연구장비 활용 교육생 모집 공고문-게시용.hwp) for full details; its content was not read for this translation.

Between 09:00 on 16 November 2026 and 18:00 on 20 November 2026, go to the Badabom website (https://badabom.go.kr) and select Workforce Development [인력양성] → Marine Research Equipment Use [해양연구장비활용] → Submit Application [신청서 제출].
In the application, enter your first-choice equipment (required) and either a second choice or 'Do not apply' ('신청하지 않음') if you want only one type of equipment.
Wait for the separate notification of your final equipment and practical session time if you are selected.
translation:
[Korea Institute of Marine Science & Technology Promotion (KIMST)] Recruitment of Trainees for Research Equipment Use at Research Infrastructure Specialised Operation Partner Institutions

□ Announcement and Application Period
 - Announcement period: Wednesday 11 November 2026 to Friday 20 November 2026
 - Application period: Monday 16 November 2026, 09:00 to Friday 20 November 2026, 18:00 ※ Applications are accepted on a first-come, first-served basis and may close early.

□ How to Apply
 - Badabom website (https://badabom.go.kr) → Workforce Development [인력양성] → Marine Research Equipment Use [해양연구장비활용] → Submit Application [신청서 제출]

□ Notes on Applying
 - Each person may apply for up to two types of equipment for practical training. The first choice is required and the second choice is optional.* * If you want only one type of equipment, please enter 'Do not apply' ['신청하지 않음'].
 - Each practical session is 90 minutes per equipment, and each session for each equipment is limited to a maximum of five trainees.
 - Equipment will be assigned according to order of preference, taking into account the applications received and the session capacity for each equipment.
 ※ The final equipment and practical session time will be notified separately when trainees are selected.
※ Please check the attached recruitment notice for details.
